problems: Overlap: all nine dossiers are sub-units of larger drawn states. kingdom-of-the-franks (eu-07-b) draws the whole realm 509-843 and subtracts only Burgundy (and Austrasia 612-613), so Austrasia, Neustria, the Spanish March and Alsace lie inside it 511-751 and must be subtracted or the Franks shape treated as the remainder. duchy-of-francia lies inside West Francia's Cliopatria shapes 850-989; march-of-pannonia and principality-of-lower-pannonia lie inside the East Franks 850-910 shape; spanish-march 795-897 overlaps Cliopatria's Ribagorza (866), Urgell (870) and Pallars (875) rows, which west-franks books as 870/872/878 losses.

duchy-of-lotharingia (903-959) is held by west-franks (911, contest 923-925) and kingdom-of-germany/east-franks (925-959) as direct land; those dossiers need vassal_start/vassal_end pairs naming duchy-of-lotharingia, or their direct holding of Lotharingia must be dropped.

kingdom-of-lotharingia: Cliopatria draws Lothair II's realm as Lower Burgundy 860-869. The 863 and 870 regions were copied from the lower-burgundy, west-franks and east-franks dossiers at build time, so they match today and could drift if those siblings are revised.

Slug choices: merovingian-neustria is deliberately not kingdom-of-neustria (eu-07-c's Cliopatria row, 717-724, whose notes ask for a Merovingian counterpart); duchy-of-lotharingia (903-959) differs from duchy-of-lorraine (eu-09, 1431-1766). The colour agent should seed both pairs with the same colour (family france); spanish-march uses family iberia, march-of-pannonia austria, principality-of-lower-pannonia east-europe.

Austrasia, Neustria and Alsace disagree between pages (Austrasia infobox 481 against text 511; Chilperic I death 583 against 584; Pribina installed 838, 839 or late 830s; Kocel succeeded 861 or 864; last Alsace duke before 742 against 747-767). Each choice is recorded in the dossier notes.

WebFetch returns a model summary of each Wikipedia page, so the quotations in notes and events are the summariser's quotations, not byte-exact page text; the reviewer should spot-check dated sentences.

The Breton_March URL returned the article on the Marches of Neustria (infobox 861-987), not the Carolingian Breton March; it was used for duchy-of-francia and the Carolingian march has no dossier. Balaton_Principality resolved to the Principality of Lower Pannonia article.
Pallars, Ribagorza, Urgell, Cerdanya and Saintes are lon/lat circles because the gazetteer has no names for them; they should be re-expressed once the names listed in gazetteer_names_needed exist.
